note: In Groton State Forest on the west shore of Ricker Pond, beside the Montpelier-Wells River Rail Trail (Cross Vermont Trail), with a campers' beach, boat launch and boat rentals. Bears are active here: food and trash go in a vehicle or a bear canister. --Claude
summary: Park page + RA site list + 2026 map: season Memorial Day Fri-2nd Mon Oct (05-22/10-12 replaces derived 05-20/10-14); 26 tent/RV (12 RV-capable, 14 tent-only), max 35 ft, only 5 sites over 20 ft; no hookups; token showers, dump, water. Fees $20/$38 (+$2 prime) confirmed on the fees page. Phone 802-584-3821 matches. WATERFRONT pond -> lakeview recommended (T29/T31 pads behind a shoreline tree strip). Pin ~610 m off (VT 232 junction in forest): move recommended. Website .html -> /parks/ricker-pond.
flags: WATERFRONT (stored pond, recommend lakeview; strict no-pond-view reading gives not waterfront): only two RV-capable sites are on the shore - T29 (20 ft, does not fit 23 ft) and T31 (28 ft), both sold by the night, both 'Proximity to Water: Waterfront' on the booking site. The booking site's own photos show both gravel pads under canopy with the pond seen through a strip of shoreline trees, and Esri imagery of the Loop C turnaround at ~44.2434,-72.2444 shows the pads ~20-35 m from the water behind a continuous wooded bank fringe. No RV pad on open ground at the water, so the on-water value is not earned. Ricker Pond is ~95 acres (agency calls it a pond); a filtered view from T31 supports lakeview, as Brighton's Spectacle Pond was kept. The stored waterfront_evidence was read at the stored pin 44.2459,-72.2537, which is a road junction ~600 m west in forest, not the campground - it is not evidence.
